data_quality_notes.lookahead_bias_description: 2021 uses full-season Savant pitcher stats (lookahead bias — no prior-year cache). 2022–2024 use proper prior-year caches (data/seasons/{year-1}/player_cache.pkl) — lookahead-safe. 2025+ also use prior-year caches. Treat 2021 ROI figures as estimates; 2022–2025 are clean out-of-sample results.
data_quality_notes.threshold_selection: Key signal thresholds (combo edge -10%, pitcher diff -0.05, totals OVER 8.0, UNDER 4.5, suppression gate 0.50) were derived by inspecting this same backtest data. They are in-sample optimized. True out-of-sample performance may differ by 2-5%.
